bloodline_blessings.canonical_nature: Metaphysical hereditary endowments unique to Arthitean royal and warrior bloodlines.

distinct_dimensions.acquisition: Whether the blessing is possessed. Historically hereditary/beginningless; now expandable retroactively via Supramajor.
distinct_dimensions.quality: The fundamental tier and metacapacity of the blessing. Toren-indexed directly proportionally to Supramajorness.
distinct_dimensions.strength: The operational power level of the blessing. Amplified by Archarthitean Factor and Deity Factor One per willpower at occurrence.
distinct_dimensions.growth_dynamics: Separately tracked from raw strength; former growth-rate and acceleration are not guaranteed to restore upon seal removal.

enlightenment_family.pressurised_enlightenment: A major breakthrough in Enlightenment that scales higher in countersurpassableness of Unprecedentedness of groundbreakingness when under greater pressure.
enlightenment_family.pressurised_hyperenlightenment: A Supramajor breakthrough in Enlightenment scaling higher in countersurpassableness under greater pressure, retroactively acquiring new Bloodline Blessings with Toren-indexed quality.
enlightenment_family.visual_manifestation: Rhayhara's eyes briefly glow brightly and hair temporarily becomes fiery-like.

phk_loop.canonical_nature: Stress-amplified exponential recursion: PHK ↑ → Physiology factors ↑ → PHK ↑ faster. Difficulty feeds the rate at which growth feeds growth.
phk_loop.varvadeil_clan_rule: The Varvadeil clan incorporates biological and brain-lobe factors that create recursive improvement feedback loops into PHK.
phk_loop.archarthitean_factor: Factor in PHK loop; Toren of Pressurised-Enlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower at occurrence (does NOT acquire new blessings).
phk_loop.arthitean_deity_factor_one: Factor in PHK loop; Toren of Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for increasing Bloodline Blessing strength per willpower at occurrence.
phk_loop.arthitean_deity_factor_two: Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment for Arthitean Deity Factor One. In the PHK loop, Factor Two applies Pressurised-Hyperenlightenment directly to Factor One, recursively amplifying the feedback loop.

ontostates_and_wings.hierarchy: Arthitean ⊂ Archarthitean ⊂ Arthitean Deity (additive inheritance: A → (A+B) → (A+B+C)).

wing_rules.arthitean_deity: 3 pairs of black-phoenix wings (Rhayhara is currently the only Arthitean Deity)

ontostates_and_wings.rhayhara_status: Currently the sole living Arthitean Deity, retaining Archarthitean and Arthitean properties with 3 pairs of black-phoenix wings.

scaling_and_metagovernance.apossible_definition: All things categorically attributable to any recursively ordered Possible levels of Metarules and All things categorically attributable to any recursively ordered Impossible levels of Metarules.
scaling_and_metagovernance.apossible_constraints: Must use 'All' (NOT 'totality'). Must preserve categorical attribution and recursive levels. Reject 'Metarule governing Impossible'.
scaling_and_metagovernance.migration_policy: Apossible and Toren supersede Lydrextent and Ultraarsayne for current scaling; Lydrextent/Arsayne retained historically in source texts and Rhayhara's legacy seal narrative.
